messages:
sam_sales: Quick internal baton — Nimbus Health signed yesterday (Enterprise). They need: private VPC, SSO (Okta), and a short dedicated nodes trial. Passing to CS for activation and ENG for infra feasibility. Procurement timeline may push GA; renewal risk if go-live >60 days. TL;DR: activation owner wanted by EOD tomorrow.

anya_cs: Thanks Sam. I can take activation owner. Can we confirm the exact VPC peering reqs and whether they need a static IP?

sam_sales: Yes — VPC peering + allowlist 3 IPs for egress. I'll drop the customer's network diagram in the ticket. Also they asked about data residency in eu-west-1.

mika_cs_manager: @anya_cs assigned as CS lead. Please capture onboarding checklist and run the first enablement session within 10 business days. Mark: renewal flagged as medium risk until we confirm trial capacity.

anya_cs: Copy. I'll schedule enablement (30m intro + 60m deep-dive). Who owns the dedicated nodes trial? @devon_eng?

devon_eng: Happy to scope the trial. Quick Q: what model variants do they expect to run? (embedding + chat reranking) Also need expected RPS and peak tokens per call.

sam_sales: They plan chat + embeddings; ~15 RPS peak, avg 800 tokens/call, spikes to 2k tokens during batch indexing. I'll attach the contract appendix with usage estimates.

devon_eng: Ok. Initial feasibility: dedicated pool with 2xA100 equivalents looks fine for trial. Need network/peering details + SSO cert. I'll open an infra ticket and link it.

leo_support: From Support side I can own runbook & on-call rotations during trial. Want to capture common failure modes and escalation path. Can someone add a short acceptance criteria list?

anya_cs: Draft acceptance criteria: 1) successful VPC peering + secure egress allowlist; 2) SSO login as >2 admin users; 3) baseline latency <200ms p50 for chat; 4) embeddings job runs end-to-end for sample dataset. Will add to the onboarding doc.

mika_cs_manager: Good. Also capture customer success metrics: time-to-first-inference, onboarding NPS (post enablement), and any feature requests. We'll tie regression alerts to their eval prompt set.

devon_eng: Infra ticket created: INF-4891 — includes initial capacity plan, network checklist, and cert owner. Command we use for private deploy smoke test: ```./deploy_smoke.sh --env=nimbus --verify --token=REDACTED```

oncall_bot: Reminder: creation of INF-4891 triggered monitoring playbook assignment to leo_support.

leo_support: I'll prepare a short runbook snippet and add a health dashboard with token-cost and latency widgets. Will also add a log filter for 5xx spikes and auth failures.

sam_sales: FYI procurement expects invoice processed in 2 weeks, they may request earlier rollout. If we miss the 60-day window they may push renewal negotiation sooner.

anya_cs: Action items: \n- anya_cs: schedule enablement + capture NPS survey link (Due: 2023-11-10)\n- devon_eng: confirm capacity & complete INF-4891 (Due: 2023-11-03)\n- leo_support: create runbook + dashboard (Due: 2023-11-06)\n- sam_sales: upload network diagram and contract appendix to the ticket (Due: 2023-10-31)

mika_cs_manager: I'll check back on Friday for status and adjust priority if procurement shows delays. If any blocker, escalate to infra lead with subject "Nimbus activation blocker".

anya_cs: Noted. I'll start enablement scheduling now and post calendar invites + pre-read.

sam_sales: Thanks team — please update INF-4891 as you make progress. I'll follow up with the customer on the IP allowlist today. :thumbsup:
